title: publish-go-packages config
description: Controls which Go modules the publish-go-packages workflow is allowed to tag and release.

$schema.description: Pointer back to this schema file, for editor validation/autocomplete. Not read by any workflow.

include.description: Glob patterns (matched against the workspace-relative directory of each tracked go.mod, e.g. "packages/global-sdk-go") whose matching modules are eligible for publish. Supports '*' and '?' wildcards.

exclude.description: Glob patterns that override 'include'. Use for modules that are still in development and must never be tagged/released automatically, even if their path matches 'include'.
